correctness.rationale: Covering each coordinate hyperplane by selected orthogonal hyperplanes gives the lower bound \(\min\{n,q+1\}\) via the sharp \(q+1\) proper-subspace cover threshold. The coordinate basis and explicit two-dimensional projective-line constructions attain the total bound. Parity gives the paired lower bound, and explicit clique, anisotropic-plane, totally-isotropic-plane, and exceptional binary constructions attain it.
